findings.F1: The pronoun-position learner error has incorrect and correct swapped, so it teaches *turn off it*.
findings.F2: switch-on-phrv, an antonym, is listed among the synonyms of sense 1.
findings.F3: Sense 3 (make someone bored or uninterested) is wrongly labeled formal.
findings.F4: The sense 1 definition is causative only, while its grammar and the oven example include an intransitive use.
findings.F5: disable-v is not a true synonym of turning off a light, machine, or supply.
findings.F6: The verb/noun stress contrast is stated in both pronunciation.notes and adaptation.pronunciation.
findings.F7: The open/close-for-lights trap is stated in both learner_errors and adaptation.false_friends.
